mods.name: Integrated Industrial Craft
mods.description:
Integrated Industrial Craft (IIC) - A comprehensive integration mod for ImprovedMobs, GregTech CEu, and Spore.

Features:
- Tri-Axis Difficulty System (Time, Voltage, Pollution)
- Dynamic pollution system with environmental effects
- Industrial threat system (mob attacks on machines)
- Spore integration with infection mechanics
- Mekanism laser turrets for base defense
- Real-time HUD display system
- Terrain scanner tool
